pwa.title: Make room for Darna on your phone.
pwa.intro: Add Darna to your home screen for a simple way back to your family home.
pwa.installedBody: You can open your family home from the Darna icon on your home screen.
pwa.accepted: Installation accepted. Follow any remaining steps from your browser.
pwa.dismissed: No problem. You can install later using your browser menu or the steps below.
pwa.failed: The install prompt could not open. Try the browser-menu steps below.
pwa.manualHint: Use the steps below if your browser does not show an install button.
pwa.prepareFailed: Darna could not finish preparing. Check your connection and reload this page.
pwa.androidStep1: Open Darna in Chrome on your phone.
pwa.androidStep2: Tap the three-dot menu, then choose Add to Home screen or Install app.
pwa.androidStep3: Choose Install when offered and confirm. Open Darna from its new icon.
pwa.androidNote: If Chrome offers a shortcut instead, you can still add it. Available options depend on your browser.
pwa.iosStep1: Open Darna in Safari, then tap Share. Depending on your layout, Share may be inside the Page menu.
pwa.iosStep2: Choose Add to Home Screen. Turn on Open as Web App if shown.
pwa.iosStep3: Keep the name Darna and tap Add. Then open it from your home screen.
pwa.iosNote: If Add to Home Screen is missing, scroll to Edit Actions in the Share menu and add it.
pwa.standaloneBenefit: Your own Darna icon, with an app-style window on supported devices.
pwa.connection: An internet connection is needed to load and update your private household data.
